_comment: EVALUATION-ONLY scenario for ml/evaluate_obstruction.py (obstruction-aware ns-3 altitude experiment). Registered only by that script; not part of configs/scenarios.json, configs/eval_network.json or any training config. urban_core is the most built-up 200 m window of the city_damaged mesh found by an offline height-map scan (72 % of 5 m cells above 5 m, roofs ~10 m, max ~19 m), centred at (500, -50). Coordinates are the Sionna scene's own (the scene XML has no transform and the OBJ is not recentred), and ns-3 receives the identical numbers through the handoff file.

urban_core.name: Urban Core (evaluation only)
urban_core.purpose: Dense built-up area where buildings obstruct UAV-user links; tests whether altitude changes ns-3 network performance once obstruction loss is applied.
urban_core.note: Users are placed by ml/obstruction.street_level_users (open ground under and within 3 m of each user, checked by ray casts on the scene), not by scenarios.generate_users.
